text: Handler: Hurried run, any word from the kennel lead. Planner: The Companion Animal Travel Desk is holding the file open and I need a clean status from the ramp side. Coordinator: <<FACT F091>> Keep the carrier checks tight and confirm the latch, bedding, and water setup before handoff. Handler: I have the kennel notes and the crate looks steady, with no loose fittings or sharp edges. Planner: Good, keep the tone calm with the traveler and avoid extra chatter while we verify the route. Dispatcher: Safety review stays simple today, so watch for heat, noise, and any delay that could unsettle Finn. Coordinator: If anything changes, flag it fast and use the shortest clear update you can give. Handler: Understood, and I will stay with the load until the final handoff is complete and logged.
